description: GlobalEnergyGIS is Niclas Mattsson and contributors' Julia tool for preparing regional energy-model inputs from public geospatial and weather data. It combines land, population and economic assumptions with ERA5 to calculate renewable potential and hourly capacity factors for wind, solar and hydropower. Users define regions through GADM or NUTS boundaries; raster preparation uses a 0.01-degree grid, approximately one kilometre at the equator. Outputs include region definitions and energy inputs for the companion Supergrid model, with weather intermediates stored in HDF5. MIT source is free, while upstream datasets retain separate terms and some require registration. A limitation is its large storage requirement, including tens of gigabytes per weather year and substantial temporary space. Documented service setup may need updating. The package can prepare inputs for infrastructure capacity simulations and relates to PyPSA (model-pypsa). No data, model archive or installer was downloaded.
